question_en: Three candidates contested an election and received 1234, 8448 and 20180 votes, respectively. What percentage of the total votes did the winning candidate get? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places) (SSC MTS 2024)

question_en: A, B and C contested an election. All the votes polled were valid. A got 38% of the total votes. For every 45 votes polled, B got 18 votes. The winner got 5,760 more votes than the person who received the least number of votes. The total number of votes polled was:

subject: Quant

question_en: In a city 60% of the population are males and the rest are females. If the ratio of married males to non married males is 5:7, and the ratio married females to non-married females is 2:3, then what percentage of the total population is married?

question_en: John gets Rs57 per hour of regular work and Rs114 per hour of overtime work. He works altogether 172 hours and his income from overtime hours is 15% of his income from regular hours. Then, for how many hours did he work overtime? (CAT 2019)
question_hi: जॉन को तनयसमत काम के प्रतत घंटे 57 रुपये और ओवरटाइम काम के प्रतत घंटे 114 रु समलते है । वह कुल समलाकर 172 घंटे काम करता है और ओवरटाइम घंट़ों से उसकी आय तनयसमत घंट़ों से उसकी आय का 15% है। फिर, उसने फकतने घंटे ओवरटाइम फकया?
subject: Quant

question_en: Every month, a man consumes 20 kg of rice and 8 kg of wheat. The price of rice is 20% of the price of wheat, resulting in a total expenditure of ₹300 per month for rice and wheat combined. If the price of wheat is increased by 20%, what percentage reduction in rice consumption is needed to maintain the same expenditure of ₹300? (Given that price of rice and consumption of wheat is constant. (SSC CGL 2024 Pre)
question_hi: हर महीने एक आदमी 20 फकलो र्ावल और 8 फकलो गेहूं खाता है। र्ावल की कीमत गेहूं की कीमत का 20% है, क्जसके पररर्ामस्वरूप र्ावल और गेहूं को समलाकर प्रतत माह ₹300 का कुल खर्ि होता है। यहद गेहूं की कीमत में 20% की वृद्धि होती है, तो ₹300 के समान व्यय को बनाए रखने के सलए र्ावल की खपत में फकतने प्रततशत की कमी की आवचयकता है? (यह देखते हुए फक र्ावल की कीमत और गेहूं की खपत क्स्थर है।
subject: Quant

question_en: A man saves a certain part of his income every month so that he can purchase a car in one year. By what percent, he must increase his savings so that he can purchase the same car in 9 months?
question_hi: एक आदमी हर महीने अपनी आय का एक तनक्चर्त हहस्सा बर्ाता है ताफक वह एक साल में एक कार खरीद सके। फकस प्रततशत तक, उसे अपनी बर्त बढानी र्ाहहए ताफक वह 9 महीने में एक ही कार खरीद सके?
subject: Quant
